lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns along the mid-flank, with a transition to higher density and less structured arrangement in the cephalic-lateral transition zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots to form a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-luminance highlights on the dorsal aspect and high-contrast shadows on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, yellow-colored commensal fish localized near the dorsal and cephalic regions.
